services.name: All Exhibitions
services.desc: The fourth annual All Eyes on You (AEOY) call for entries had no set theme. We invited artists to submit work that reflects their strongest ideas, materials, and ways of working. The result is a wide range of voices and approaches, each grounded in personal experience. Harking back to AEOY I, the first open call for work from outside the collective, each member of the collective selected one piece that spoke to them. These choices were guided not by a set of rules, but by individual connection-what felt meaningful, compelling, or familiar to each of the 18 artist members.
